headline: Movida shares plunge 16% as high interest rate expectations shadow solid Q3 results
summary: Shares of Brazilian rental company Movida dropped 16% despite solid third-quarter financial performance. Investors were concerned that domestic interest rates will stay elevated for longer.
why: Car rental firms rely heavily on debt financing to purchase vehicle fleets, making earnings highly sensitive to benchmark interest rates.

impacts.name: Movida Participacoes S.A.
impacts.why: High interest rate projections weighed heavily on fleet funding cost outlooks.

why_moved: Expectations of prolonged high interest rates in Brazil outweighed solid operational performance.
